violet: Hi all  quick/awkward HR question: I'm in the middle of IVF and have a scheduled embryo transfer on May 22. I may need 2-3 days off around the procedure and then 1-2 weeks for recovery if we have a positive result. What does Redwood consider for fertility/medical leave, how do I file for pay (STD vs PTO), and what docs are needed?

harry: Huge congrats and thanks for asking. Short answers: medical appointments tied to fertility treatment are covered as medical leave under STD if your plan covers it  check your carrier. You can also use PTO for short appointments. If you need more extended leave for pregnancy after a positive test, file parental leave + STD when appropriate.

anya: HR detail: 1) For a short-term procedure (2-3 days), submit a short medical leave request in the portal and note "fertility treatment/IVF". 2) If it's unpaid/you're using PTO, indicate PTO days. 3) STD claims typically require a provider note or medical certification covering the dates. 4) For job protection later, FMLA/CFRA can apply once pregnant; submit forms then.

violet: Is there any company top-up for IVF-related medical leave?

harry: We don't have a separate "IVF top-up" but company-paid sick time and STD top-up rules apply. If STD pays a portion, you can use PTO to top to full pay. For parental leave later (primary caregiver), Redwood's parental top-up still applies after birth/adoption.

mike: Manager/coverage note: violet  please create a 1-page handoff with any on-call rotations and list 1-2 folks who can cover urgent pages for the 2-3 day window. We don't need a contractor for short absences. For longer parental leave we'll talk about handoffs then.

payroll-bot: AUTOMATED: "Medical leave request received for violet (thread 1770001111). To process STD or PTO top-up, upload provider note and confirm leave dates in the portal. For payroll timing: submit docs at least 7 business days before payroll cutoff to guarantee payment on the next run."

hr-bot: AUTOMATED: "Note: fertility treatments are treated as medical leave where applicable. Please contact benefits@redwood.com if you want confidential help with STD claim or benefits options."

violet: Thanks everyone  I'll submit a short medical leave request and upload the clinic note. Appreciate the support.

anya: Also FYI: Redwood offers an employee assistance program (EAP) and an infertility counseling benefit in the benefits portal. DM me if you want us to route the claim or schedule a benefits walk-through.

mike: Thanks team  noted and thanks for the heads-up, violet. We got you. :heart:
